title: Azure Blob

fields.name: auth_type
fields.description: Specify the type to authenticate against the service.

fields.name: shared_key
fields.description: Specify the Azure Storage Shared Key to authenticate against the service.

fields.name: sas_token
fields.description: Specify the Azure Storage shared access signatures to authenticate against the service.

fields.name: container_name
fields.description: Name of the container that will contain the blobs.

fields.name: auto_create_container
fields.description: If container_name does not exist in the remote service, enabling this option will handle the exception and auto-create the container.

fields.name: path
fields.description: Optional path to store your blobs.

fields.name: emulator_mode
fields.description: If you want to send data to an Azure emulator service like [Azurite](https://github.com/Azure/Azurite), enable this option so the plugin will format the requests to the expected format.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.description: If you are using an emulator, this option allows you to specify the absolute HTTP address of such service.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Azure Blob output plugin allows ingesting your records into Azure Blob Storage service.
